name: type:feat
description: New behavior or rule.

name: type:fix
description: Defect or broken workflow.

name: type:refactor
description: Restructure without behavior change.

name: type:docs
description: Operator docs, standards, or README changes.

name: type:tracking
description: Umbrella issue coordinating scoped child issues.

name: state:rfc
description: Proposal is open but not yet actionable.

name: state:parked
description: Explicitly deferred until new evidence or owner decision.

name: severity:security
description: Security-sensitive work requiring investigation bias.

name: severity:non-ascii-content
description: Non-ASCII content boundary signal for issue, PR, or comment text.

name: semver:major
description: Universal-text change breaks backward compatibility; bumps apm.yml MAJOR.

name: semver:minor
description: Universal-text change is a backward-compatible addition or clarification; bumps apm.yml MINOR.

name: semver:patch
description: Universal-text change is non-normative surface only; bumps apm.yml PATCH.

name: area:ci-ops
description: CI automation scripts, issue/PR operation utilities, and maintenance workflows.

name: area:governance
description: Repo structure analysis, document dependency graph, and governance tooling.

name: area:security-intel
description: Threat triage, security drift, non-ASCII defense, and security runbooks.

name: ops:dependencies
description: Dependency update workflow state from Dependabot or equivalent automation.

name: ops:retro-opened
description: auto-retro opened or reused the retrospective for a terminal PR.

name: retro:tp
description: Operator-confirmed true positive: follow-up landed and is reducing repair loops.

name: retro:fp
description: Confirmed false positive: retro fired on weak signals with no genuine repair loop.

name: retro:fp-candidate
description: Scanner-detected drift: follow-up stale or unresolved; operator confirms fp or relabels tp.

name: retro:tentative
description: Auto-opened with low prior confidence (label-derived prior below the skip threshold).

name: retro:expired
description: Sentinel closed as not_planned after inactivity; weak fp signal, counted apart from tp/fp.

name: type:retrospective
description: Auto-opened retrospective reviewing repair-free merge reproducibility after a merge.
